sources.title: National Housing Delivery Fund
sources.publisher: Homes England and National Housing Bank
sources.verified_claim: The National Housing Delivery Fund can support land, remediation and infrastructure for housing-led schemes using advice, debt, equity, grants and guarantees; funding availability does not establish support for any sample parcel.

sources.title: Enquire about funding and support from the National Housing Delivery Fund
sources.publisher: Homes England and National Housing Bank
sources.verified_claim: Homes England states NHDF investment decisions may be changed or withdrawn until due diligence and signed agreements are complete and explicitly advises against assuming an application will succeed.

sources.title: National Housing Delivery Fund information
sources.publisher: National Housing Bank and Homes England
sources.verified_claim: The official collection links NHDF guidance, enquiry routes and programme documentation, providing provenance for funding rules rather than site-level funding evidence.

sources.title: National Housing Delivery Fund and how the National Housing Bank can help
sources.publisher: National Housing Bank and Homes England
sources.verified_claim: The National Housing Bank may deliver NHDF support through loans, equity and guarantees where market finance is insufficient; these tools remain conditional financing mechanisms, not parcel awards.

sources.title: Homes England — our funds and interventions
sources.verified_claim: Homes England's official portfolio lists NHDF, National Housing Bank, affordable housing programmes and land interventions; it is a programme index rather than proof of local project participation.

sources.title: Social and Affordable Homes Programme 2026 to 2036 information
sources.verified_claim: Homes England records programme routes, documentation and delivery deadlines; the programme is outside London and therefore is national comparator context only for these London sample parcels.

sources.title: Apply for grants from SAHP 2026 to 2036: Continuous Market Engagement
sources.verified_claim: The CME route allows eligible providers to apply for SAHP funding subject to programme rules and funding availability; the programme applies outside London and is not treated as London parcel funding.

sources.title: Healthy Homes
sources.verified_claim: Homes England updated Healthy Homes guidance on 8 July 2026 to clarify its role in design quality, sustainability and resilience for housing partners; it is guidance, not a planning consent or funding award.
